$comment: Market indicators tracked by SteelScope. Values are published only when a verified, legally usable observation exists in data/market/observations.json (each with a source name and URL). No values are estimated or generated by AI. To connect a licensed price feed later, write observations in the same format from the pipeline.
note: Iron ore updates automatically each month. Other prices are added by SteelScope from verified market sources.
